question: What are the key catalysts for Diginex?

beats.line: So the big one first. Diginex committed to updating us on its unified strategy through the second quarter of twenty twenty-six.
beats.headline: Q2 2026
beats.action: A single halftone paper calendar page drops onto a cream chip and settles flat.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] So the big one first. Diginex committed to updating us on its unified strategy through the second quarter of twenty twenty-six.
beats.narration: So the big one first. Diginex committed to updating us on its unified strategy through the second quarter of twenty twenty-six. That's the critical near-term catalyst. And what people want to see? That the four acquired businesses actually run as one platform, not four silos.

beats.line: Then there's Resulticks. A one point five billion dollar acquisition — the transformative bet.

beats.delivery: [excited] Then there's Resulticks. A one point five billion dollar acquisition — the transformative bet.

Does its customer data and AI drive extra revenue from existing Diginex customers, and the other way round? Without cross-sell evidence, it's a financial burden instead.

beats.line: Here's what's already working. Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent year on year to two million dollars, driven mainly by subscription.
